traits.name: Defiant
traits.description: Through any force of nature, your character remains a stalwart sentinel in the face of great danger.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.

ranks.effect: Your Death Threshold is 15.
Your Death Threshold is 20.
Whenever you are Resuscitated, Gain 5 Health and Soak.

traits.name: Gifted
traits.description: Possessing superhuman abilities and surpassing the prowess of your kin, your character stands as an extraordinary and gifted exemplar among their kind.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.

ranks.effect: Your maximum Focus increases by 2.
Your maximum Reflex increases by 2.
Your maximum Luck increases by 1.

traits.name: Hawkeye
traits.description: Naturally gifted with keen vision and steady aim, your character excels with ranged weapons, landing precise shots at distances others wouldn’t even attempt.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.

ranks.effect: Your Quick Attacks using ranged weapons now deal +1d4 bonus damage.
Your Normal Attacks using ranged weapons now deal +1d6 bonus damage.
Your Heavy Attacks using ranged weapons now cost 4 Stamina instead.

traits.name: Sixth Sense
traits.description: Endowed with psionic prowess, your character possesses the ability to detect presence, emotions, thoughts, and even glimpse into the future with profound psychic insight.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.

ranks.effect: Your maximum Reflex increases by 2.
You cannot be surprised as long as you have 2 Focus.
Your Base Dice cannot be lowered when spending Stamina.

traits.name: Leader
traits.description: Commanding yet inspiring, your character rallies allies in moments of crisis, guiding groups with steady confidence and turning the tide through teamwork.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.

ranks.effect: At the start of combat, teammates gain 5 Soak if they are either within your line of sight or earshot. This effect can only occur once per combat.
At the start of combat, teammates gain temporary Focus if they are either within your line of sight or earshot. This effect can only occur once per combat.
At the start of combat, teammates gain 3 temporary Reflex if they are either within your line of sight or earshot. This effect can only occur once per combat.

traits.name: Observant
traits.description: Exceptionally perceptive, your character notices what others overlook, catching subtle details and detecting trouble before it strikes.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.

ranks.effect: Add a 1d4 Bonus Die when rolling Sense Action Dice.
Your maximum Focus increases by 2.
At the End of a Turn, you can either convert your leftover Stamina into Reflex or Focus (but Focus needs 2 Stamina per conversion instead).

traits.name: Charismatic
traits.description: With effortless charm and magnetic presence, your character wins trust, sways crowds, and navigates social situations with grace and persuasion.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.

ranks.effect: Add a 1d4 Bonus Die when rolling Influence Action Dice.
Targets you influence have -1d4 Penalty when rolling Reaction Dice.
Enemies within 3m have a -2 penalty to their Defense Dice against you.

traits.name: Bright
traits.description: Quick-witted and clever, your character solves problems and puzzles with ease, always ready with a smart solution or a sharp retort.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.

ranks.effect: Add a 1d4 Bonus Die when rolling Intellect Action Dice.
Increase All Action/Reaction Dice when Making an Intellect Roll by 2 sizes.
Reduce any Risk Threshold you encounter by half.
